1.keywords: mask + remove/merge fields + JSON = ETL; every 15 min batch; 'easily expandable'
1.trap: Lambda→SQS→Fargate = self-built ETL; every new field = code change + redeploy
1.rule: ETL + expandable/least overhead → Glue crawler + classifier + Glue ETL job. Data Exchange never transforms.

8.keywords: weekly CSV; avg memory; RECOMMENDED config; cost savings; least dev overhead
8.trap: Lambda Insights = monitoring only, no recommendations/savings
8.rule: Right-sizing recommendations + savings → Compute Optimizer (ExportLambdaFunctionRecommendations → S3).

10.keywords: SFTP; keep Elastic IP; partner IP allowlist via SG; HA; minimize management
10.trap: Public Transfer Family endpoint can't attach EIP/SG
10.rule: Transfer Family VPC endpoint, internet-facing → attach EIP + security group; S3 as storage.

14.keywords: 40-min transcode; idle 35%; HA + scalable + reduce management; most cost-effective
14.trap: EC2 ASG polling SQS still = managing EC2; Lambda max 15 min
14.rule: Long job (>15 min), event-driven → container on Fargate, Lambda calls ECS RunTask.

35.keywords: Lambda timeout on long videos; never time out again; no servers to manage
35.rule: Lambda timeout → containerize (ECR) + Fargate task started by Lambda. Both picks = one solution.

28.keywords: hybrid Linux+Windows; different patch tools; consolidated patch status
28.trap: Config = config compliance, not patch operations
28.rule: Patching + patch compliance (EC2 + on-prem) → SSM managed nodes + Patch Manager.

38.keywords: thousands of accounts; standardized VPC; auto-deploy to NEW accounts
38.trap: Self-managed stack sets in member accounts
38.rule: Org-wide CFN → StackSets trusted access + service-managed permissions in mgmt account + automatic deployment.

51.keywords: rotate SSH keys on fleet managed by SSM Fleet Manager
51.trap: Downloaded .pem = PRIVATE key; authorized_keys needs PUBLIC key
51.rule: Key rotation → new key pair, extract public key, push via SSM Run Command (AWS-RunShellScript).

68.keywords: QA members create own environments from CFN templates; no broad permissions
68.trap: Elastic Beanstalk = convert templates, grants broad perms
68.rule: Self-service provisioning with least privilege → Service Catalog product + launch constraint.

72.keywords: MP4 → HLS; cost-effective; HA; global remote viewers
72.trap: Jenkins + EC2 + EBS = DIY, low HA
72.rule: Video transcoding → Elemental MediaConvert + S3 + CloudFront.

73.keywords: webhooks; migrate to serverless; most operationally efficient
73.rule: Simple HTTPS endpoint for a function → Lambda Function URL.

24.keywords: WorkSpaces; restrict to HQ + satellite offices; new office soon; operational efficiency
24.trap: Windows Firewall in custom image = per-WorkSpace management
24.rule: Restrict WorkSpaces by source network → WorkSpaces IP access control groups.

16.keywords: hundreds of accounts; OU per team; team lead sees charges across OU accounts
16.rule: Org-wide cost breakdown → CUR from management account + QuickSight dashboard.

29.keywords: bill analytics division by tag 'expenseUnit: analytics'
29.rule: Cost by tag → activate user-defined cost allocation tag in mgmt account + CUR tag breakdown.

19.keywords: critical SGs must not be modified; only PROD OU
19.trap: aws:SourceIp condition doesn't target specific resources
19.rule: Protect specific resources → tag them + SCP deny with aws:ResourceTag condition, attach to OU.

31.keywords: IDENTIFY instances missing tag AND PREVENT creation; org-wide list
31.trap: Security Hub / Inspector don't check tags
31.rule: Prevent → SCP deny RunInstances w/o tag; Detect → Config rule; org-wide list → Config aggregator.

67.keywords: central shared VPC; Customers OU create resources but not manage
67.trap: SCP not needed — shared-VPC participants can't modify VPC anyway
67.rule: VPC sharing → enable RAM sharing with Organizations + RAM share subnets to OU principal.

18.keywords: staging account frequently re-provisioned; connect to TGW in IT ops account
18.trap: VPC endpoint per application doesn't scale
18.rule: Cross-account TGW → share TGW via RAM + auto-accept attachments.

54.keywords: existing on-prem AD; group/role-based access; manage identities in one place
54.trap: Import users into AWS Managed AD = duplicate identity store
54.rule: Existing IdP → IAM Identity Center + SAML 2.0 + SCIM auto-provisioning + ABAC.

36.keywords: move Lambda + Aurora to another account, same org + Region; least downtime
36.rule: Aurora cross-account copy fast → share cluster via RAM + Aurora clone.

62.keywords: virtual appliances; scale dynamically; centralized networking account via TGW
62.trap: Direct Connect = on-prem link, not appliance scaling
62.rule: Scalable 3rd-party appliances → Gateway Load Balancer (+ PrivateLink endpoint) + ASG launch template.

9.keywords: multi-Region DR; RDS MySQL; RTO 30 min; RPO 1 h; Route 53
9.rule: RTO < ~1 h → cross-Region read replica + automated promotion + Route 53 failover record.

61.keywords: RTO ≤ 30 min; secondary ASG capacity 0; read replica in DR Region
61.rule: Pilot light → Route 53 failover policy + Lambda scales ASG + promotes replica.

42.keywords: serve from CLOSEST Region (fastest); fail over if unavailable
42.rule: Fastest + failover → latency alias record + Evaluate Target Health (+ health checks).

20.keywords: DR with minimal data loss + analytics slowing primary
20.rule: DR + read offload → cross-Region read replica (analysts query it) + copied AMIs.

57.keywords: single DX + private VIF; add redundancy; new VPC in another Region
57.trap: One private VIF can't reach VGWs in 2 Regions
57.rule: Multi-Region over DX → 2nd DX connection + Direct Connect Gateway + VIF per connection.

4.keywords: VMware → EC2; preserve software stacks + configuration
4.trap: SSM + Image Builder builds NEW AMI, doesn't preserve VM
4.rule: Lift VM as-is → VM Import/Export (export OVF → S3 → import-image).

32.keywords: on-prem Windows file server; data needed by servers in AWS; Direct Connect
32.trap: File Gateway stores data in S3, not a Windows file system in AWS
32.rule: Windows files in AWS → FSx for Windows + DataSync scheduled replication.

33.keywords: hundreds of Hyper-V servers; processes, CPU/memory, network dependencies
33.rule: Migration discovery + assessment → AWS Transform discovery tool + assessment job + reports.

63.keywords: assess TCO before migrating K8s + DBs
63.trap: Application Discovery Service = inventory/dependencies, not TCO
63.rule: TCO / business case → Migration Evaluator (Collector + Quick Insights).

49.keywords: 18 apps; mostly idle except weekly/quarter-end; <1–3 GiB; most cost-effective
49.trap: RIs sized to ASG max = paying for idle capacity
49.rule: Many small intermittent apps → containerize, ECS on EC2 cluster (bin-packing) + scale on memory.

55.keywords: event-driven SERVERLESS; real-time analytics; streamline data flows
55.rule: 'Serverless' in question → pick serverless variants: Aurora Serverless, Redshift Serverless, EventBridge.

74.keywords: legacy app SMTP port 25 no TLS → SES
74.trap: IAM role doesn't work for SMTP interface
74.rule: App speaking SMTP → SES SMTP credentials + SES SMTP endpoint + port 587 STARTTLS.

5.keywords: SNS → many Lambdas → RDS; CPU high; slow/lost updates at peak
5.trap: SNS retry policy doesn't reduce DB load
5.rule: Lambda overwhelming RDS → RDS Proxy + SQS queue per Lambda to buffer.

58.keywords: Lambda + Aurora; many idle DB connections at high demand
58.trap: API Gateway endpoint type/rate limits irrelevant
58.rule: Connection storm → init DB connection outside handler (reuse) + RDS Proxy.

30.keywords: Fargate can't reach Aurora; DB_HOST env var; password in Secrets Manager
30.trap: SG direction reversed (inbound on Fargate SG)
30.rule: Fix = cluster endpoint in DB_HOST + DB SG inbound from Fargate:3306 + secret via ValueFrom.

13.keywords: stateful LAMP on EC2 + Aurora; both tiers auto-scale
13.trap: Aurora can't auto-scale writers; NLB = L4 no HTTP stickiness
13.rule: Aurora Auto Scaling = READ replicas only; stateful web tier → ALB + sticky sessions + ASG.

12.keywords: S3 origin in EU; NA users slow; LEAST latency
12.trap: Global Accelerator can't front S3; S3TA doesn't move data (REPEAT)
12.rule: Move data close → S3 CRR to us-east-1 + Lambda@Edge switches origin for NA users.

22.keywords: only 'master' satellite prefix; replicated within 30 min; monitor
22.rule: Replication SLA → prefix-filtered replication rule + S3 Replication Time Control (15 min) + metrics.

23.keywords: Lake Formation data lake; only approved networks; no public internet
23.rule: Private + network-restricted S3 → Gateway endpoint + S3 access point + bucket policy s3:DataAccessPointArn.

69.keywords: expose services to other AWS customers; stay off internet
69.trap: ALB cannot back a VPC endpoint service
69.rule: PrivateLink endpoint service → Network Load Balancer (or GWLB), never ALB.

21.keywords: release times pre-set; ECS on EC2; S3 in same Region via NAT; reduce cost
21.rule: Known schedule → scheduled scaling; S3 via NAT → free Gateway VPC endpoint.

15.keywords: browsing vs checkout load imbalance; JWT; CloudFront already in front
15.trap: API Gateway + Lambda authorizer adds latency/complexity
15.rule: Independent scaling → separate ECS services; lightweight edge routing on JWT → CloudFront Functions.

48.keywords: OpenSearch read-only after 1 wk; delete index after 3 mo; keep full audit copy
48.trap: S3 IA pricier than Deep Archive for rarely-read audit copy
48.rule: OpenSearch tiering → UltraWarm + ISM to cold; audit archive → S3 Glacier Deep Archive.

2.keywords: migrate web app + PostgreSQL; high traffic peaks; scale seamlessly; low overhead
2.watch: Shared file storage for web tier
2.rule: Replatform web app → Elastic Beanstalk (ALB + ASG) + EFS for shared files + managed DB.

3.keywords: global users upload PDFs to S3; Regional API GW; slow for distant users
3.watch: Transfer Acceleration = uploads to S3; edge-optimized = API latency
3.rule: Global uploads → S3 Transfer Acceleration; global API callers → edge-optimized endpoint.

6.keywords: DX + Transit Gateway + DX Gateway; on-prem reach VPCs
6.watch: Allowed prefixes must cover VPC CIDRs
6.rule: DX Gateway ↔ TGW → advertise allowed prefixes = VPC CIDR (same or wider).

7.keywords: multi-account VPCs via TGW; dev↔dev, prod↔prod, no dev↔prod
7.watch: Default TGW route table connects everything
7.rule: Segmentation on TGW → separate route tables per environment, disable default association/propagation.

11.keywords: thousands of EC2 incl. high-memory; analyze efficiency; act on recommendations
11.watch: Memory metrics need CloudWatch agent — Compute Optimizer alone sees CPU only. ⚠️ Missed same service in Q8
11.rule: Right-sizing → Compute Optimizer (opt-in, ≥12h data) + CloudWatch agent for memory.

17.keywords: FSx for Windows Single-AZ must become Multi-AZ
17.rule: FSx Single-AZ → Multi-AZ: new Multi-AZ file system + DataSync copy + repoint apps.

25.keywords: Managed Blockchain; patient PII; transparent + immutable; private entities
25.watch: Never store raw PII on-chain (immutable = can't delete)
25.rule: Blockchain + PII → hash on-chain, PII off-chain (DynamoDB).

26.keywords: hundreds of accounts, many Regions; S3 usage trends; 6 months history
26.watch: Free metrics keep only 14 days — need advanced metrics
26.rule: Org-wide S3 usage/cost insight → S3 Storage Lens (org dashboard + advanced metrics).

27.keywords: CloudFront → ALB; intermittent 502; show custom error page
27.watch: Error page must live outside the failing origin
27.rule: Custom error page → S3 origin (OAC) + CloudFront custom error response.

34.keywords: single EC2 unresponsive at peak; read-heavy PostgreSQL; minimal dev effort
34.rule: Reliability → ASG + ELB; read scaling → Aurora + Aurora Replicas.

37.keywords: VPC flow logs gzip text in S3; Redshift Spectrum queries slow/costly
37.rule: Query-heavy logs → Parquet output + hourly partitions.

39.keywords: framework install 15–20 min in user data; faster deployment
39.rule: Slow boot bootstrap → golden AMI (SSM Automation AWS-CreateImage / Image Builder).

40.keywords: API GW + Lambda + RDS MySQL; high invocations, connections, CPU
40.watch: ⚠️ Same fix you missed in Q5/Q58 (RDS Proxy)
40.rule: Connection pressure → RDS Proxy; read load → ElastiCache for Redis.

41.keywords: multiple accounts, more added later; log API activity everywhere
41.rule: Org-wide auditing → organization trail in management account.

43.keywords: only supervisory roles run IAM actions across ALL accounts; minimal admin
43.watch: IAM policies per account = high admin
43.rule: Org-wide guardrail → SCP at root OU denying IAM actions for non-supervisory principals.

44.keywords: each OU views detailed cost breakdown of member accounts
44.watch: ⚠️ Same concept you MISSED in Q16 (picked RAM there) — review both together
44.rule: Org cost breakdown → CUR in management account → S3 → QuickSight dashboard.

45.keywords: CFN role in Account A assumed by EC2 in Account B; access denied
45.watch: Fix is the TRUST policy in the role owner's account
45.rule: Cross-account AssumeRole → role's trust policy in A names B's instance role ARN (+ B allows sts:AssumeRole).

46.keywords: VMware VMs; preserve software/config; SMB log/backup share
46.watch: ⚠️ Same services you missed in Q4 (VM Import) and Q32 (FSx+DataSync)
46.rule: Lift VM as-is → VM Import/Export; SMB share → FSx for Windows + DataSync.

47.keywords: SQL Server Always On → heterogeneous migration; managed services
47.rule: Heterogeneous DB migration → AWS SCT (schema) + DMS (data) to RDS.

50.keywords: EC2 fleet polls SQS, stores .json on EFS; optimize cost
50.watch: EFS costlier than S3 for object output
50.rule: SQS worker fleet → Lambda triggered by SQS; object output → S3 not EFS.

52.keywords: virtualized Ubuntu + Windows; actual usage + dependencies
52.watch: ⚠️ Same service you missed in Q33 (AWS Transform discovery)
52.rule: Discovery + dependency mapping → AWS Transform discovery tool + migration planning.

53.keywords: Aurora PostgreSQL; cross-Region DR; RPO < 1 minute
53.watch: Snapshots/cross-Region replicas can't guarantee sub-minute RPO
53.rule: RPO < 1 min cross-Region Aurora → Aurora Global Database (+ CFN to provision DR infra).

56.keywords: Lambda must reach Neptune in private subnets + DynamoDB
56.watch: Lambda in VPC loses internet → endpoint or NAT
56.rule: Lambda to VPC resource → Lambda in private subnets + SG rule; DynamoDB via gateway endpoint or NAT.

59.keywords: .NET monolith; uneven resource use; domain in Route 53; scale per function
59.watch: Keep the domain — custom domain on API Gateway
59.rule: Split monolith by function → Lambda per component + API Gateway + custom domain.

60.keywords: custom SFTP on EC2 + cron to S3; reduce management
60.watch: ⚠️ Same service you missed in Q10 (VPC endpoint + EIP detail)
60.rule: SFTP to S3 → AWS Transfer Family; point Route 53 record at server endpoint.

64.keywords: containerized .NET; HA SQL Server; connection string not in container
64.rule: HA SQL Server → RDS Multi-AZ; creds → Secrets Manager injected into Fargate task.

65.keywords: GitHub + CodePipeline; test feature branch separately
65.watch: Don't mix test artifacts with prod pipeline
65.rule: Branch-based testing → separate pipeline per branch + CodeBuild tests + separate test account.

66.keywords: ASG replaces unhealthy instances; logs sent every 5 min get lost
66.watch: Default result CONTINUE so termination isn't blocked
66.rule: Save data before termination → lifecycle hook EC2_INSTANCE_TERMINATING + SSM Automation.

70.keywords: GitHub Actions; replace static IAM user keys
70.rule: CI/CD from GitHub → IAM OIDC identity provider + role trusting sts:AssumeRoleWithWebIdentity.

71.keywords: Managed AD integrated with on-prem AD; VPN from anywhere; MFA
71.rule: Remote users + AD + MFA → AWS Client VPN with AD Connector + MFA.

75.keywords: department heads: alert when spend exceeds threshold + monthly reports
75.rule: Per-account spend alerts → AWS Budgets (filters per account) in mgmt account + Cost Explorer reports.
